content:
The Chorus/Assault/Warden split has been kinda meaningless at best and misleading at worst for the longest time. It provides no mechanical benefit, and only really serves to be memed on by people who played the game for any duration of time. It would be nice if Awakeners either got recategorized to better represent their main use (GOgier as Assault, Kath as Warden, Helot as Chorus, ect), introduce a 4th category to try and better define Chorus as a role, and/or give some minor generic mechanical bonus to the roles so that it's more than just flavortext?

content:
I've seen people defending the dps tilt Gogier is leaning towards because full tanks are hard to balance for, and that sustain gameplay is antithetical to the devs' vision, and while I can see where they're coming from: we have a built-in shield cap and other tanks who can already hit said cap. Salvador is the premier sustainer; Bottomless Scar exists to kill him and sustain teams specifically and he can still limp along to victory, and players push on like that *because they like that type of gameplay* regardless of the devs' intentions. Castor, despite increasing clowning for his powercrept Corrosion, still is an excellent tank.
Wardens already have the least amount of units in their pool, so the least a Warden can do is actually fulfill the role on their label? Instead of being a middling dps??
